methods.name: startTrackUser
methods.docs:
Starts watching a circular area. When the device enters or leaves it, the plugin POSTs
a check-in or check-out to `apiEndPoint`, also when the app is in the background or closed.
Calling it again replaces the previous area. Works the same on iOS and Android.

Asks for location permission if needed. Background tracking needs "Always" (iOS) or
"Allow all the time" (Android).

methods.name: stopTrackUser
methods.docs: Stops watching the area and forgets the saved endpoint, user ID and token.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.docs: Whether tracking is on, the area being watched, and how many requests are waiting to be retried.

methods.name: getCurrentLocation
methods.docs:
Gets the device's current location once. Asks for location permission if needed ("While Using"
is enough). While tracking is on, the result also says how far the device is from the area's
centre and whether it is inside.

Rejects with code `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `LOCATION_DISABLED` (location switched off on the device),
`TIMEOUT` or `UNAVAILABLE`.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.docs: The current location permissions, without asking the user.

methods.name: requestPermissions
methods.docs:
Asks for location permission, then for background location ("Always" on iOS, "Allow all the
time" on Android), and resolves with the result. Permissions already granted or denied are
not asked again. `startTrackUser` also asks by itself, so calling this first is optional.

methods.name: addListener
methods.docs:
Called when the device enters or leaves the area. Only while the app is running: an event
that happens while the app is closed still reaches your server, but not this listener.

methods.name: addListener
methods.docs: Called when a check-in or check-out request is sent, saved for retry, rejected or dropped. Only while the app is running.

properties.name: lat
properties.docs: Latitude of the area's centre. A number or a numeric string.

properties.name: long
properties.docs: Longitude of the area's centre. A number or a numeric string.

properties.name: radius
properties.docs:
Radius in metres. Defaults to 5. Both platforms detect boundary crossings reliably only
from about 100 m.

properties.name: apiEndPoint
properties.docs:
URL that receives a `multipart/form-data` POST with `latitude`, `longitude` (the area's centre),
`aid`, `auth_token`, `checkin` (`"true"` on entry, `"false"` on exit), `timestamp` (when it
happened, ISO 8601 UTC) and `event_id` (unique per entry or exit).

If the request fails (no network, timeout, 408, 429 or 5xx), it is saved and retried in order,
so use `timestamp` for the attendance time and `event_id` to ignore duplicates.

properties.name: userID
properties.docs: Sent as `aid`. A whole number or a numeric string.

properties.name: auth_token
properties.docs: Sent as `auth_token`. Defaults to an empty string.

properties.name: isTracking
properties.docs: True between `startTrackUser` and `stopTrackUser`, also after the app restarts.

properties.name: latitude
properties.docs: The area being watched. Only set while tracking.

properties.name: pendingRequests
properties.docs: Requests saved for retry and not yet delivered. They are still sent after `stopTrackUser`.

properties.name: accuracy
properties.docs: How far off the position may be, in metres.

properties.name: altitude
properties.docs: Metres above sea level, if known.

properties.name: altitudeAccuracy
properties.docs: How far off the altitude may be, in metres, if known.

properties.name: speed
properties.docs: Metres per second, if known.

properties.name: heading
properties.docs: Direction of travel in degrees from north (0 to 360), if known.

properties.name: timestamp
properties.docs: When the device measured this location, ISO 8601 in UTC.

properties.name: distanceFromCenter
properties.docs: Metres from the centre of the area being tracked. Only set while tracking.

properties.name: isInsideArea
properties.docs: Whether the device is inside the area being tracked. Only set while tracking.

properties.name: enableHighAccuracy
properties.docs: Use GPS for the best accuracy. Slower and uses more battery. Default `true`.

properties.name: timeout
properties.docs: Give up after this many milliseconds. Default `10000`.

properties.name: maximumAge
properties.docs: Accept a location the device already has if it is at most this many milliseconds old. Default `0`: always get a new one.

properties.name: location
properties.docs: Location while the app is in use. Android needs precise location.

properties.name: backgroundLocation
properties.docs: Location while the app is in the background or closed: "Always" on iOS, "Allow all the time" on Android.

properties.name: eventId
properties.docs: Same as the `event_id` sent to the server.

properties.name: transition
properties.docs: `enter` for a check-in, `exit` for a check-out.

properties.name: timestamp
properties.docs: When it happened, ISO 8601 in UTC. Same as the `timestamp` sent to the server.

properties.name: latitude
properties.docs: Latitude of the area's centre.

properties.name: longitude
properties.docs: Longitude of the area's centre.

properties.name: status
properties.docs:
- `sent`: the server answered with a `2xx` status.
- `queued`: sending failed (no network, timeout, `408`, `429` or `5xx`), or earlier requests
  are still waiting. It is saved and retried; a later `sent` follows if the app is running then.
- `rejected`: the server answered with another status, such as `400` or `401`. Not retried.
- `dropped`: it waited more than 7 days (or, on iOS, more than 100 requests were waiting). Not sent.
